pinev: 1894 and 1898 Stillwater directories list George Vollmer on 'S Main' with no house number.
1900 US census, Stillwater Ward 2, sheet 1: Margaret Volmer, 79, b. 1820 Germany, widow, head, with niece Othilie, at 305 So. Main St, a few months after the 1899 search.

Placed from modern MnGeo address points: 301 S Main is at 45.0549,-92.8053 (E side) and 302-308 at 45.0547,-92.8057 (W side); r80 covers both sides of the 300 block. Whether the 1900 numbering matches today's is not checked.

Stillwater Sanborn: 305 S. Main was a storefront in the Grand Opera House block, so the widow's 1900 household lived above or behind a downtown store; the 1899 house full of hidden money may have been this building or an earlier dwelling.

Minneapolis Journal, 23 Oct 1899: the will gave each daughter $5 and the remainder to the two sons; the daughters contested for undue influence. A second independent paper for the will contest, before the November search.
